If the latitude-corrected CGM value materially changes the Sq current-system claim, the WIN-010 assessment needs to be revised or a hedge added.
≤30% ceiling citation: curmudgeon could not locate the ≤30% ceiling on Sq contributions from the cited sources. Find the citation or reframe the claim with a hedge.
α range justification: the α=0.7–0.9 range appears uncited. Verify or add a citation/hedge.
Gaussian/power-law alternative wording: the alternative fit characterization lacks a formal goodness-of-fit comparison. Add a parenthetical hedge or document a formal comparison.
Kim & Chang page range: the cited page range may not be standard for this reference. Verify in Kim & Chang (2007) and correct if needed.
